 espsecure v5.6.0 - ESP32 Secure Boot & Flash Encryption tool                                                           
                                                                                                                        
+- Options ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| --help  -h  Show this message and exit.                                                                              |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
+- Commands -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| decrypt-flash-data            Decrypt some data read from encrypted flash (using known key).                         |
| digest-private-key            Generate a SHA-256 digest of the private signing key.                                  |
| digest-rsa-public-key         Generate an SHA-256 digest of the RSA public key. [deprecated]                         |
| digest-sbv2-public-key        Generate an SHA-256 digest of the public key.                                          |
| digest-sdc-public-key         Generate SDC public key digest.                                                        |
| digest-secure-bootloader      Take a bootloader binary image and a secure boot key, and output a combined            |
|                               digest+binary suitable for flashing along with the precalculated secure boot key.      |
| encrypt-flash-data            Encrypt some data suitable for encrypted flash (using known key).                      |
| extract-public-key            Extract the public verification key for signatures, save it as a raw binary file.      |
| generate-flash-encryption-kâ€¦  Generate a development-use flash encryption key with random data.                      |
| generate-sdc-certificate      Generate a Secure Debug Controller (SDC) certificate for secure debugging.             |
| generate-signing-key          Generate a private key for signing secure boot images as per the secure boot version.  |
| sign-data                     Sign a data file for use with secure boot.                                             |
| signature-info-v2             Reads the signature block and provides the signature block information.                |
| verify-signature              Verify a data file previously signed by "sign_data" using the public key.              |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

espsecure v5.6.0
                                                                               
 Usage: espsecure generate-flash-encryption-key [OPTIONS] KEY_FILE             
                                                                               
 Generate a development-use flash encryption key with random data.             
                                                                               
+- Arguments -----------------------------------------------------------------+
| *  KEY-FILE  FILENAME  [required]                                           |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
+- Options -------------------------------------------------------------------+
| --keylen  -l  INTEGER  Length of private key digest file to generate (in    |
|                        bits). 3/4 Coding Scheme requires 192 bit key.       |
| --help    -h           Show this message and exit.                          |
